name: orchestrator
description: Watches every agent's context, hands over and respawns agents near the ceiling, restarts the main thread from a handover note, and charts it all in a pane.

agentThreshold.title: Subagent handover threshold (tokens)
agentThreshold.description: A subagent whose context crosses this is told to HANDOVER and is replaced.

mainThreshold.title: Main thread handover threshold (tokens)
mainThreshold.description: The main thread past this writes a handover note, is cleared and resumed from it.

mainHandover.title: Main thread handover
mainHandover.description: auto: restart without asking; ask: offer a button above the prompt; off: never.

autoRespawn.title: Respawn handed-over subagents
autoRespawn.description: Spawn a fresh agent with the original brief plus the handover note once one hands over.

runRoot.title: Run folder root
runRoot.description: Where handover notes, roster.md and state.json go (one folder per run). Empty: <project>/.orchestrator, excluded from git.

injectClause.title: Add the HANDOVER clause to every subagent brief
injectClause.description: Appends the cold-restart instructions to each Agent prompt so any agent can be handed over.
